overview: A 12-tool productivity dashboard with a premium glassmorphism UI, dark/light theme toggle, live currency rates, QR/barcode generators, image tools, PDF toolkit, calculators, and AI text humanization — all accessible from a single responsive dashboard with quick-jump navigation.

Quick-jump sidebar navigation to all tools
Currency Converter with live exchange rates
Password Generator, QR Code, Barcode Generator
PDF Toolkit (merge, split, compress, images to PDF)
Text Style Generator with Unicode styles
Age, Loan EMI, and BMI calculators
AI Text Humanizer via external API
Fixed header with branding and theme toggle
